---
name: Feature proposal
about: Propose a concrete mathematical capability or API improvement
---

## Use case

What computation should a caller be able to perform? Show a small input/output or
API example, if possible.

## Mathematical contract

Describe the definition, conventions, primary references, and how correctness
could be checked independently.

## Scope

What existing functionality can be reused? Note alternatives and compatibility
implications. Application workflows and language bindings belong outside the core.
